subject: ClearCart: Conversion lift from POC & quick quote request
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearcart.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC wrap — quick summary

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the support during the pilot — we ran the variant on ~120k product page views over two weeks and wanted to share the headline numbers before we hop on a call:

- Baseline checkout conversion (control): 3.8%
- Variant (Redwood-inferenced personalization): 6.1%
- Absolute lift: +2.3 percentage points (≈60% relative lift)
- Incremental checkouts attributed to the model: ~2,760
- Average model latency (p95): 320ms — within our SLO for page load async calls
- Estimated inference cost per incremental checkout: down ~21% vs. our previous host (primarily due to batching/KV-cache savings)

We attached the short POC report (clearcart-poc-summary.pdf) and a chart of daily lift (conversion-lift-chart.png). Overall this exceeded our expectations — engineering and growth are aligned to move a smallish experiment into production traffic next quarter.

A couple asks from our side: would Redwood be comfortable if we shared a one-sentence blurb and the two metrics above (absolute lift and cost-per-checkout reduction) as a customer quote? Also happy to do a 15-minute postmortem call next week to discuss rollout considerations.

Best,
Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Growth | ClearCart

Attachments: clearcart-poc-summary.pdf (12 pages, PDF), conversion-lift-chart.png (PNG)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearcart.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@clearcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC wrap — quick summary

Hi Claire — incredible to see these numbers, thanks for sharing and congrats to the ClearCart team.

High level reaction from our side: the +2.3pp (≈60%) uplift is exactly the sort of outcome we optimize for on this workload; the latency and cost delta you reported align with the opt-in batching + KV caching profile we expected.

We'd love the simple one-liner and permission to publish the two metrics you called out. Draft suggestion (feel free to edit):

"Redwood helped us lift checkout conversion from 3.8% to 6.1% while reducing inference cost per incremental checkout by ~21%." — Claire Huang, Head of Growth, ClearCart

If that looks good, Marissa and I will coordinate a short marketing clearance and use the quote alongside the POC chart. If you prefer, we can take a live 15-minute call to talk rollout knobs (rate limiting, canary cadence, cache warm-up) — I'm available Wed Dec 2 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu Dec 3 09:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks again — excited to make this public with you if you'd like.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
